implementation_binding_note: The 44-run census, metrics, intervals and decision thresholds were frozen before confirmatory support was added. The runner hash was added before any confirmatory run.
sizing_result: The predeclared largest log-throughput standard-deviation rule selected 11 repetitions per worker level.
queue: PostgreSQL JobRepository claim/lease; no broker or control-plane Redis

intervals.method: Deterministic 10000-resample percentile bootstrap over the 11 repetitions.
intervals.seed: SHA-256 of this canonical confirmatory plan

broker_threshold.decision: BROKER_EVALUATION_REQUIRED only when 8/4 median throughput is <=1.05 and 8/4 median queue-wait P95 is >=1.25; otherwise POSTGRES_QUEUE_RETAINED.
broker_threshold.correctness_gate: Any error, duplicate ownership or nonterminal Job fails the run and prevents a scaling decision.

reporting: Publish all 44 repetitions, the 1-worker baseline, absolute and relative deltas, 95% intervals, local process/heap/SQL scope, and the measured broker decision.
